_comment: Function-call schema examples, not executable tools or an MCP server. Supply your own HTTP adapter using each function's x-redlog-requests; read ~/.redlog/api-token and api-port. Parameters use API field names. Path parameters are substituted, GET parameters are query strings, POST parameters are JSON.

function.name: redlog_session_register
function.description: Register a session ID for already enabled capture. Once the registry is nonempty, only registered IDs pass this additional filter. Does not install, enable or broaden working-directory permission.

session_id.description: Actual current session ID from the calling tool metadata

cwd.description: Optional working directory, echoed only; grants no capture permission

function.name: redlog_mark
function.description: Create a timestamped marker in the RedLog attack timeline. Use when you discover a vulnerability, start a new testing phase, or want to note something important.

notes.description: Additional context, reproduction steps, or technical details

target_id.description: Target host, IP, or URL this relates to

function.name: redlog_log_event
function.description: Log an external observation. Accepted agent_type values: scanner, shell, terminal, dns, external, agent, marker, process, credential_use, file_transfer, screenshot, browser, http_navigation, pcap. Derived events are produced by RedLog itself.

data.description: Event payload. Populate standard keys when applicable.

function.name: redlog_search
function.description: Search across all RedLog events (shell commands, targets, loot) by keyword.

function.name: redlog_status
function.description: Get the current RedLog status including IP/VPN state, event count, scope violations, and recording state.

function.name: redlog_scope
function.description: Get configured targets and scope violations; the response has no exclusions field.

function.name: redlog_loot_scan
function.description: Scan text for credentials, secrets, API keys, JWTs, password hashes, private keys, database URLs, and CTF flags.

text.description: Text to scan for embedded secrets or credentials

function.name: redlog_bookmark
function.description: Create a private bookmark for a URL or point of interest.

note.description: Notes about why this is interesting

function.name: redlog_screenshot
function.description: Capture a screenshot of the current desktop state.

function.name: redlog_whoami
function.description: Return the operator identity this API token resolves to. Call once at session start to confirm your events are being attributed correctly.

function.name: redlog_operators_list
function.description: List every operator token registered on this RedLog instance.

function.name: redlog_chain_status
function.description: Return evidence-chain length plus the latest OpenTimestamps anchor status (complete/partial/failed/pending).

function.name: redlog_chain_anchor_now
function.description: Submit the current chain head to public OpenTimestamps calendars immediately. Use before ending a session or right after a critical finding to lock its timestamp into the Bitcoin blockchain via OTS.

function.name: redlog_chain_verify
function.description: Fast integrity check: confirm the latest anchor still describes a prefix of the current event chain.

function.name: redlog_chain_upgrade
function.description: Fetch upgraded OpenTimestamps proofs from calendars for pending anchors. Wait at least a few hours after anchoring; the calendar has to fold your digest into a Bitcoin-anchored Merkle tree first. With id, substitute it into the specific-anchor path and send no JSON fields. Without id, use the upgrade-all path.

id.description: Specific anchor id. Omit to upgrade all pending.

function.name: redlog_config
function.description: Get the current RedLog project configuration (engagement, operator, network, scope).

function.name: redlog_events
function.description: Query recent timeline events, optionally filtered by type or target.

agent_type.description: Filter stored events by agent_type (including derived events)

function.name: redlog_bookmarks_list
function.description: List all private bookmarks in the current project.

function.name: redlog_recording
function.description: For action=status use GET /api/recording with no parameters. For pause/resume/toggle use POST /api/recording with JSON {action}. Pauses/resumes are logged as system.recording_paused/resumed events.
